layer: configs/scout_var_alloc_v1.json (tools/scout_var_alloc.py, src/prc2026_scout/var_alloc.py): two LightGBMs (log squared residual; P(late)) and the slope k, fitted on the four development months (runs/daily_totals/rows.parquet with v48 and the extreme-day layer month-blocked); settings, features, eligibility, cap 100 s and floor unchanged

procedure.P(pool): models fitted on the pool's eligible rows; the out-of-month weights of each pool month from models fitted on the pool without that month; k = var_alloc.slope over the pool's eligible rows on those weights. rule: ACCEPT only if (1) the summed dSSE over the four held months (January, July, February, June 2025) is negative, (2) the February and June point estimates are both <= 0, and (3) no held month is worse than +0.005%.
